observations.title: Approve a server pack and download it
observations.player_action: Connect with AutoModpack and review the server certificate fingerprint before trusting the pack.
observations.outcome: The client obtains the hash-indexed manifest and files, using Modrinth/CurseForge direct sources where available.
conditions: JEM installs 5.0.0-rc.1 through jem-bootstrap.jar; the general project page may describe a later release.
